cases.selectionRationale: Hea-strt quest terrain, arrival and generation; map reveals source layout and role-specific inhabitants. This is forced arrival rather than earning quest permission.
cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Hea-strt. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Hea-strt before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Hea-strt entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.

localComparison.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Hea-loca. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Hea-loca before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Hea-loca entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.
localComparison.wholeSourceScope: Whole dat/Hea-loca.lua including top-level level_init/flags, map or procedural selections, traps, objects, monsters and role-specific quest conditions, with load_special/makelevel production loader registration. Audit every consumed Lua/descriptor helper and preserve source order; no whole mklev/teleport/questpgr credit.
requiredDependencies: nhlib.lua private alignment shuffle before program execution
sp_lev.c / nhlobj.c descriptor, selection, object and monster helpers used by this exact whole Lua program

cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Hea-goal. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Hea-goal before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Hea-goal entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.

cases.mission: Knight uses wizard destination menu to enter Kni-loca, then maps that quest level
cases.selectionRationale: Kni-loca quest terrain, arrival and generation; map reveals source layout and role-specific inhabitants. This is forced arrival rather than earning quest permission.
cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Kni-loca. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Kni-loca before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Kni-loca entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.

cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Mon-strt. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Mon-strt before invoking makemaz. cases.selectionRationale: Mon-goal quest terrain, arrival and generation; map reveals source layout and role-specific inhabitants. This is forced arrival rather than earning quest permission.
cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Mon-goal. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Mon-goal before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Mon-goal entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.

localComparison.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Mon-goal. Audit every consumed Lua/descriptor helper and preserve source order; no whole mklev/teleport/questpgr credit.

C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Ran-strt before invoking makemaz. localComparison.wholeSourceScope: Whole dat/Ran-strt.lua including top-level level_init/flags, map or procedural selections, traps, objects, monsters and role-specific quest conditions, with load_special/makelevel production loader registration. Audit every consumed Lua/descriptor helper and preserve source order; no whole mklev/teleport/questpgr credit.

cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Sam-loca. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Sam-loca before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Sam-loca entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.

localComparison.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Sam-loca. C begins the private Lua alignment shuffle (nhlib.lua:shuffle) and generates this program; JS mklev.js:makelevel checks SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS and refuses Sam-loca before invoking makemaz. The loader registry in quest_levels.js has no Sam-loca entry. The preceding menu/startup prefix matches; this is a distinct missing Lua program, rather than an already missing menu command.
localComparison.wholeSourceScope: Whole dat/Sam-loca.lua including top-level level_init/flags, map or procedural selections, traps, objects, monsters and role-specific quest conditions, with load_special/makelevel production loader registration. Audit every consumed Lua/descriptor helper and preserve source order; no whole mklev/teleport/questpgr credit.
requiredDependencies: nhlib.lua private alignment shuffle before program execution
sp_lev.c / nhlobj.c descriptor, selection, object and monster helpers used by this exact whole Lua program
Existing role quest destination, quest arrival text and level map/vision owners; name uncovered callers/returns before implementation

cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step19 selects the native C menu destination Val-strt. localComparison.wholeSourceScope: Whole dat/Val-goal.lua including top-level level_init/flags, map or procedural selections, traps, objects, monsters and role-specific quest conditions, with load_special/makelevel production loader registration. Audit every consumed Lua/descriptor helper and preserve source order; no whole mklev/teleport/questpgr credit.
